name: dashboard_ui
description: Dashboard V3: primary task → primary info → secondary → context → action; never four KPI cards by default
when_to_use: Dashboard / 后台 / 控制台 / admin / console / analytics board / KPI / 数据看板 / 仪表盘 — multi-panel product UI (not marketing landing, not poster)
prompt_negative: Never default to four equal KPI cards. Name the primary task first. Do not invent metrics, chart series, or logos. Do not paint a festive poster or a marketing landing.

zh-CN.description: 后台 V3：先定主任务，再排主信息→次信息→上下文→操作；禁止四张 KPI 默认墙

en.description: Dashboard V3: primary task first — never four KPI cards as the default
